privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains how we collect and use your data.

sections.title: 1. Data Controller
sections.content: The data controller is TelecomBGLabs. For questions regarding the processing of personal data, you can contact us via the "Contact" page.

sections.title: 2. What data do we collect?
sections.content: We collect your name, phone number, and optionally your email address, as well as your quiz responses regarding your telecom needs.

sections.title: 3. Legal Basis for Processing
sections.content: The processing of personal data is carried out on the basis of explicit consent from the user, according to Art. 6, para. 1, item "a" of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR).

sections.title: 4. Why do we collect it?
sections.content: Data is used solely to contact you and offer suitable telecom plans.

sections.title: 5. Storage Period
sections.content: Personal data is stored for the period necessary to carry out contact and consultation, but no longer than reasonably necessary, unless legislation requires a longer period.

sections.title: 6. Data Protection
sections.content: We do not sell your data to third parties. It is stored securely and used only for consultation purposes. Data is not used for marketing purposes. It may only be shared for the purpose of communicating regarding the requested service.

sections.title: 7. Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your data at any time. To exercise your rights, you can contact us via the "Contact" page.

sections.title: 1. Description of Service
sections.content: TelecomBGLabs provides independent consultations for choosing telecommunication services. We are not an operator.

sections.title: 2. No Guarantees
sections.content: We do not guarantee availability or specific prices, as they are determined by the providers.

sections.title: 3. Responsibility
sections.content: The user is responsible for providing accurate information.

sections.title: 4. Limitation of Liability
sections.content: TelecomBGLabs is not responsible for decisions made based on the information provided, nor for the actions or omissions of third parties, including telecommunications service providers.

sections.title: 5. No Obligation to Contract
sections.content: Using the platform does not create an obligation to enter into a contract with a service provider. The user independently decides whether to accept a given offer.

sections.title: 6. Applicable Law
sections.content: These general terms and conditions are governed by the legislation of the Republic of Bulgaria.

sections.title: 7. Changes to Terms
sections.content: TelecomBGLabs reserves the right to update these general terms and conditions, and the current version is always available on the site.
